source.title: Arabic WordNet data (AWN v2)
source.attribution: Abouenour Lahsen, Karim Bouzoubaa, Paolo Rosso (c) 2015, Mohammed V Rabat University, Morocco and Universitat Polit?cnica de Val?ncia, Spain; Musa Alkhalifa and Sabri Elkateb (c) 2007, UPC and the University of Manchester. Arabic WordNet data, CC BY-SA 3.0.

selection.method: Deterministic SHA-256 ordering of unique, unambiguous source lemma+part-of-speech rows with a source-declared valid Arabic root or broken plural; includes ten source-verified sample records.

contentPolicy: No Arabic definitions, examples, morphology, or semantic facts are synthesized. Original source lemma and source-declared root/plural are retained; normalized lemma is computed by the existing project normalizer. Derived dataset and modifications remain CC BY-SA 3.0.
